items.question: Did Brazil's real interest rate go up or down over the last few months?
items.answer: Brazil's real rate (Selic target minus IPCA 12m) went down over the last few months, falling from 11.19 pp in 2026-02 to 9.17 pp in 2026-09, with a small uptick from 9.61 in 2026-06 to 9.81 in 2026-07 before declining again. The 2026-09 reading of 9.17 pp is the lowest in the series shown. This reflects the Selic cut to 13.75% alongside a higher IPCA 12m of 4.58%.

items.question: O dólar subiu ou caiu contra o real nas últimas semanas?
items.answer: Na última semana disponível (2026-10-16 para 2026-10-19), o PTAX USD/BRL passou de 5.08 para 5.06, uma queda, e o fechamento semanal de USD/BRL passou de 5.10 para 5.03, também uma queda. No período mais longo (2026-08-21 a 2026-10-19), o PTAX foi de 5.16 para 5.06, portanto o dólar caiu contra o real nas últimas semanas.

items.question: Are market inflation expectations for this year above the target ceiling?
items.answer: Yes. The Focus survey median for IPCA 2026 is 5.22% (2026-10-16), above the 4.5% ceiling of the 1.5-4.5% target band, up from 4.92% four weeks earlier.

items.question: Is the US yield curve inverted?
items.answer: No, the US yield curve is not inverted. The 10y-2y spread (curve_10y2y) was 0.35 pp on 2026-10-16, positive, down from 0.44 on 2026-10-09, so it is still upward sloping though narrower.

series_used.label: US curve 10y - 2y
series_used.source: computed from FRED DGS10 and DGS2

items.question: Which stocks were the most volatile over the last year, in Brazil and in the US?
items.answer: In Brazil, the most volatile stock over the trailing year was EMBJ3 (37.72% vol), followed by GGBR4 (29.43%) and WEGE3 (28.93%). In the US, the most volatile was NVDA (37.28% vol), followed by AMZN (34.58%) and MSFT (32.84%).
